tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List every action available to the agent, including input schemas and side-effect flags.

tools.name: run_action
tools.description: Create an action job. External writes always wait for workspace-owner approval in the dashboard; the owner is emailed, and wait_for_job blocks until the decision.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the current status and result of an action job.

tools.name: list_job_reconciliations
tools.description: Read the owner's append-only observations about an unknown write. These are owner reports, not verified provider facts, a changed job status, or permission to retry. Agents cannot record observations.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Wait for an action job to reach a decision or a final state: approved and executed, rejected, failed, or execution_unknown. A job still awaiting owner approval when the timeout elapses is returned as awaiting_approval; call again to keep waiting. Keep timeout_seconds below your client's tool timeout

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List recent job and callback events for workflow continuation and audit.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the workspace-approved HTTPS API connections and their method/path allowlists. Credentials are never returned.

tools.name: list_usage
tools.description: List metered action debits and the current UTC-month usage total.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_connections" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the workspace-approved HTTPS API connections and their method/path allowlists. Credentials are never returned.
